subject: Request: SDE2 offer & headcount sign-off (REQ-4729 / Priya Sharma)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDE2 offer & headcount sign-off (REQ-4729 / Priya Sharma)

Hi Laura / Karthik —

Attaching the proposed standard SDE2 (L4) offer for Priya Sharma (REQ-4729). This is a backfill for ENG-204 (left May '27). Quick summary:

- Base: $170,000
- Target bonus: 15% (discretionary)
- Equity: 12,000 RSUs over 4y, 1y cliff (recommended by recruiting)
- Signing bonus: $0 initially (candidate asked for flexibility)
- Cost center: 5012 (platform infra)
- Proposed start window: late Aug / early Sep 2027

Attachments: offer summary PDF, headcount approval form, and the L4 comp band.

Ask: can you please review and sign off on the base/bonus/equity mix and confirm headcount budget is OK? If you'd rather adjust equity vs. a sign-on cash component, I can update and re-circulate. We need final approval today if possible so we can send a formal DocuSign offer to Priya by EOD.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring (on behalf of Hiring Manager)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SDE2 offer & headcount sign-off (REQ-4729 / Priya Sharma)

Thanks for the summary, Jasmine. Overall the base and target bonus sit within our L4 band, but two quick asks before I sign:

1) Can you confirm the hiring manager (Ben Carter) has committed to the 8/15 start window? I want to avoid a stale offer if we need a later start.
2) Equity looks a touch high given recent calibrations for this team — can we drop to 10,000 RSUs and offer a $10k sign-on instead if Priya prefers cash? That keeps total comp competitive but keeps the band consistent.

If Ben confirms the start and agrees to the $10k sign-on in lieu of 2k RSUs, I am comfortable signing off.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Talent Operations

Laura / Jasmine —

Cost center 5012 has room in the quarterly headcount budget; finance confirmed the hire is approved under the FY27 headcount plan (see attached REQ-4729 approval). From a comp control perspective I support reducing equity to 10,000 RSUs and adding a $10k sign-on bonus to meet candidate expectations. That preserves long-term alignment while allowing the candidate some upfront flexibility.

If Marissa (comp authority) can sign off on the split (10k RSU + $10k sign-on), we should be green to send the DocuSign. Also confirm Ben (hiring manager) will be fine with the start-window; if not, we should push the offer acceptance deadline accordingly.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance & Talent Budgeting

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Formal offer: Redwood Inference - SDE2 (L4) — Priya Sharma

Hi Priya —

Great speaking yesterday. Per our conversation and approvals, please find the formal offer attached and a DocuSign link below. Summary of the finalized package: 

- Base salary: $170,000 per year
- Target bonus: 15% of base, discretionary
- Equity: 10,000 RSUs vesting over 4 years (1y cliff)
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (paid first payroll after start)
- Start window: target Aug 15, 2027 (flexible within 60 days)

This offer has been approved by Talent Ops and Finance. Attachments: Priya_Sharma_Offer_Summary.pdf (formal offer), REQ-4729-headcount-approval.pdf, comp-band-L4.pdf. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE123. Let me know if you have any questions — happy to jump on a quick call.

Welcome (hopefully) to Redwood Inference — we think you'd be a great fit for the infra team.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Recruiting Lead, Engineering Hiring
---
Priya Sharma replied within 20 minutes: "Thanks — reviewing now, will sign by tomorrow morning unless there are changes. Appreciated!"
